findings.claim: In the owner-rules-only adapter, install or update with no overlay checkout returns restart_required with 'owner rules not installed', so the command exits 0 although nothing was written. That was acceptable in ClaudeAdapter, where the hooks were still installed. For this component the block is the only work, so reporting success and asking for a restart is misleading. Status in the same situation returns unsupported, so the two actions disagree.

Status distinguishes 'no checkout' from 'current' by matching the note text with strings.HasPrefix(note, "owner rules not checked"). Changing the wording in claudeOwnerRules.status silently turns the no-checkout case into supported. A typed return value would avoid the coupling.

evidence: Compared the ClaudeAdapter refactor with the base: the messages and statuses of install, update, uninstall and status are preserved.
Reviewed the new adapter and the cmd wiring for the non-claude target refusal and for --config-root handling.
